## File Naming Convention (v7.0)

### Scripts
- `kiro_*_safe.ps1` - Encoding safe versions
- `kiro_v7_*.ps1` - v7.0 specific scripts
- `*_safe.bat` - Encoding safe batch files

### Documentation
- `kiro_v7_*.md` - v7.0 specific documentation
- `*_guide.md` - User guides
- `*_system.md` - System documentation

### Configuration
- `*.json` - Configuration files
- `*.template` - Template files
- `*.db` - Database files

This system ensures all KIRO v7.0 documents are properly managed and updated.
